display.purpose: The wordmark and app-detail page title. The largest type in the product.

title.purpose: Catalog card titles. The CardTitle primitive is a smaller 16px variant.

body.purpose: Descriptions, nav, button labels, meta, dialog body — the workhorse.

label.purpose: Badges, status labels, and the smallest meta. Uppercase is not used.

shadows.name: card-rest-ring
shadows.purpose: The hairline edge separating cards and dialogs from the canvas at rest. Not a border, not a shadow — a ring.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: shadow-md, paired with a 2px lift. Only on a clickable catalog card the user is actively hovering.

shadows.name: status-float
shadows.purpose: shadow-sm on the floating StatusBadge pill, so it reads as just above the card.

motion.name: card-hover
motion.purpose: The catalog card's lift-and-shadow on hover over 150ms.

motion.name: color-fade
motion.purpose: Nav links and text shifting between muted and foreground.

motion.name: dialog-in
motion.purpose: AlertDialog open/close: 100ms fade plus a 95% zoom. The scrim fades over the same 100ms.

motion.name: skeleton-pulse
motion.purpose: Loading skeletons breathe to signal progress without noise.

motion.name: spinner
motion.purpose: Loader2 spinner inside pending Install/Uninstall buttons.

motion.name: button-press
motion.purpose: Buttons give 1px of physical press feedback; they stay flat otherwise.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The inverted near-white call to action — the single forward action on a screen ('Install App').
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.375rem; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; border-radius: var(--radius); border: 1px solid transparent; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font-family: 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Danger as a soft tint, not a shout — bg-destructive/10 with destructive text, deepening on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.375rem; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; border-radius: var(--radius); border: 1px solid transparent; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--destructive) 10%, transparent); color: var(--destructive); font-family: 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--destructive) 20%, transparent); } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--destructive) 40%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--destructive) 20%, transparent); } .ds-btn-destructive:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary/cancel control — bordered background surface that washes to muted on hover ('Retry Loading', 'Keep App').
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.25rem; height: 1.75rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; border-radius: var(--radius); border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font-family: 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Catalog Card
components.description: The catalog unit: hairline ring at rest, lifts to a shadow on hover. 48px icon, title beside a category pill, two-line description.

components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 1rem; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 1.4); background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 10%, transparent); transition: all 150ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.10), 0 2px 4px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.10); } .ds-card-icon { width: 3rem; height: 3rem; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 0.8); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 8%, transparent); color: var(--foreground); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card-head { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-family: 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-card-desc { margin: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.625; color: var(--muted-foreground); }

components.name: Category Badge
components.description: The fully-rounded pill that labels an app's category. Secondary surface tint, small label type.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 1.25rem; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 2.6); background: var(--secondary); color: var(--secondary-foreground); font-family: 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Signature component — the only operational color in the UI. A floating pill with an 8px dot whose color is the signal: green = running, yellow = installing, red = error.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; height: 1.25rem; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--background) 80%, transparent); color: var(--foreground); font-family: 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); } .ds-status-dot { width: 0.5rem; height: 0.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-status-running { background: #22c55e; } .ds-status-installing { background: #facc15; } .ds-status-error { background: #ef4444; }

components.name: Skeleton
components.description: Loading placeholder. muted surface that breathes via pulse, shaped like the real card so the loading-to-loaded transition is calm.
components.css: .ds-skeleton { padding: 1rem; border-radius: var(--radius); border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--card); } .ds-skel-icon { width: 3rem; height: 3rem; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 0.8); margin-bottom: 1rem; background: var(--muted); animation: ds-pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-skel-line { height: 0.625rem; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 0.5); margin-bottom: 0.5rem; background: var(--muted); animation: ds-pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-skel-w75 { width: 75%; } .ds-skel-line:last-child { width: 100%; height: 2.5rem; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.5; } }

components.css: .ds-dialog-scrim { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.10); backdrop-filter: blur(2px); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-dialog { width: 100%; max-width: 20rem; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 1.4); background: var(--popover); color: var(--popover-foreground); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 10%, transparent), 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); } .ds-dialog-body { padding: 1rem; text-align: center; } .ds-dialog-title { margin: 0 0 0.375rem; font-family: 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-dialog-desc { margin: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-dialog-footer { display: flex; flex-direction: column-reverse; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 1rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted) 50%, transparent); border-bottom-left-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 1.4); border-bottom-right-radius: calc(var(--radius) * 1.4); } .ds-dialog-action { height: 2rem; border-radius: var(--radius); border: 1px solid transparent; background: var(--destructive); color: var(--foreground); font-family: 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-dialog-footer { flex-direction: row; justify-content: flex-end; } }

narrative.overview:
This is a workbench, not a showroom. The LibrePod Marketplace is the surface a non-technical owner opens to install and remove apps on their own device, and every element here earns its place by doing work — nothing is here to impress. The result is a dark, flat, near-monochrome surface: plain surfaces, honest verbs ("Install App", "Keep App"), and a single red that states danger plainly. The mood is calm and restrained first, technical-but-gentle second, and honest in its voice throughout. Restraint is the design.

Depth and color are both spendthrift here, and that is the point. Surfaces sit flat at rest, separated by hairline rings rather than dropped shadows; a card only lifts and casts a shadow in the moment it is being touched. Color is rarer still: the entire neutral palette is pure achromatic grayscale, and saturated color appears in exactly two roles — a muted red for danger, and the green/yellow/red dots that report whether an app is running, installing, or erroring. When color does appear, it is a signal the owner must read, never decoration.

The product ships dark (decision D-02 forces the .dark class before mount to avoid a flash), so the dark tokens are the operational defaults; the light-mode tokens are vestigial — new work must look right in dark first. Density is compact and app-tight (14px body, 32px default button height, a 280px-min card grid): this is a tool the owner uses, read at a glance, not a page they browse.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first, near-monochrome Operate surface; light mode is vestigial.
Pure achromatic neutrals; saturated color reserved for danger + live status only.
Flat at rest; rings, shadows, and lift appear only as a response to state.
Single typeface (Geist); weight and size carry hierarchy, not a second face.
Compact, honest controls; plain verbs; one red for consequence.

rules.name: The Signal-Only Rule
rules.body: Neutral surfaces are pure achromatic (oklch chroma 0). Saturated color appears in exactly two roles: destructive for danger or removal, and the status dots for live reconciliation state. Color is never used for branding, accent, or decoration. If a new surface wants color, ask what signal it carries — if none, it stays gray.

rules.name: The Dark-First Rule
rules.body: Design and evaluate every surface in dark mode first; the light tokens are vestigial and the product ships dark (D-02). A screen that only works in light is not done.

rules.name: The One-Face Rule
rules.body: One typeface (Geist) for everything. Hierarchy comes from size and weight alone — never from introducing a second family, a display serif, or a monospace accent.

rules.name: The Depth-Is-State Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Rings, shadows, and lift may appear only as a response to state — hover, press, focus, or modal elevation. A resting shadow is a bug.

rules.name: The Honest-Corner Rule
rules.body: Modest radii (8-14px) for working surfaces; reserve the fully-rounded pill (rounded-4xl / rounded-full) for tags and status — small, secondary labels that need to read as discrete chips, not containers.

dos: Do design and evaluate every surface in dark mode first — the product ships dark (D-02); light tokens are vestigial.
Do keep neutral surfaces pure achromatic; let saturated color carry a signal only (destructive danger, or a status dot). See The Signal-Only Rule.
Do keep surfaces flat at rest; introduce rings, shadows, and lift only as a response to hover, press, focus, or modal elevation. See The Depth-Is-State Rule.
Do build hierarchy with size and weight within the single Geist face, not a second typeface. See The One-Face Rule.
Do use modest radii (8-14px) for working surfaces and reserve the full pill for tags and status. See The Honest-Corner Rule.
Do write plain, honest verbs that state consequence ('Install App', 'Uninstall App', 'Keep App') — the copy is part of the design.
donts: Don't apply saturated brand or decorative color to general UI surfaces. Color is a signal medium, not an accent.
Don't use gradients, glassmorphism, or decorative blur. The only blur in the product is the dialog scrim (backdrop-blur-xs behind bg-black/10).
Don't design light-mode-first, or assume a light canvas. Evaluate in dark before anything else.
Don't introduce a second typeface, a display serif, or a monospace accent to 'add personality' — restraint is the personality.
